subject: Expose backward-compatible indexing CLI mode
description: The indexing function is implemented but scripts/process_vlm.py main still always calls process(), so a Java ProcessBuilder cannot request the backend-ready envelope. Add an explicit backward-compatible CLI output mode (for example --output-mode vlm|index, default vlm). In index mode call process_index_payload and print its JSON; default behavior must remain the existing exact VLM JSON. Do not reinterpret output_urls. Add focused CLI tests for default compatibility, mock index-envelope stdout, invalid mode, and fail-closed real mode without de-identification. Run the full requested VLM/embedding suite, compileall, and diff check; commit excluding .gjc and record evidence.
